answer.rationale: Incumbent refused to reopen price and cannot meet the mandated 18% component spend cut, while the low-cost vendor quoted a price that satisfies the mandate alone. Memory c2 documents that moving primary supply to the low-cost vendor cut unit cost sharply with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, supporting minimal total cost of ownership without adding delivery risk. With the primary contract expiring in 14 days and no auto-renew, and assembly running at 94% with no buffer, switching primary vendor is the only action that meets the financial mandate and leverages proven low-cost vendor performance.
